summary: Russian forces launched a massive combined strike on Ukraine on the night of 19 July using 166 air attack assets including 41 missiles and 125 drones, primarily targeting Kyiv. Ukrainian forces struck multiple Russian logistics and energy targets including oil depots in Moscow and Stavropol regions and vessels in the Black Sea. Fighting on the eastern front continued with Russian advances near Pazeno and Rodinskoye and airstrikes on Kramatorsk and Zaporizhzhia.
key_points: Russian forces launched 166 air attack assets including 41 missiles and 125 drones overnight on 19 July, with main direction Kyiv; 126 targets were shot down or suppressed (Source: @kpszsu/69144).

Ukrainian Defense Forces struck the Mykhailivska oil depot in Stavropol Krai for the third time and hit eight electrical substations in Crimea and four shadow fleet vessels in the Black Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/82762).
Zelensky confirmed strikes on two major logistics objects in Moscow and Tambov regions over 500 and about 700 km from the front line used for sanctioned drone components (Source: @UkraineNow/82742).
Enemy advanced near Pazeno and Rodinskoye according to updated DeepState map (Source: @DeepStateUA/23664).
Three Russian guided aerial bombs hit Kramatorsk killing 2 and wounding 1 per Donetsk OVA head Filashkin (Source: @UkraineNow/82749).
Russian guided aerial bombs struck private sector in Zaporizhzhia wounding five including two children per Ivan Fedorov (Source: @UkraineNow/82748).
GenStab reported strike on oil depot in Moscow region, tankers and guard ship Svetlyak in Kerch, and railway bridge over Bila river in Luhansk region (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
Over 42 ballistic missiles were launched at Kyiv and region per mon1tor_ua calling it a record (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69204).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted a massive combined aerial strike on Ukraine on the night of 19 July with 166 attack assets including 41 missiles and 125 drones primarily aimed at Kyiv, of which 126 were downed or suppressed. Ukrainian forces simultaneously struck deep into Russian territory hitting oil depots in Moscow and Stavropol regions, substations in Crimea, and shadow fleet vessels in the Black Sea. On the eastern front Russian forces advanced near Pazeno and Rodinskoye while airstrikes on Kramatorsk and Zaporizhzhia caused civilian casualties.

points: Air defense forces intercepted or suppressed 126 targets overnight on 19 July including 17 Iskander-M/Tsircon/S-400 missiles, 1 Kh-59/69 missile and 108 drones of various types out of 166 detected (Source: @kpszsu/69144).

President Zelensky confirmed Ukrainian strikes on two significant logistics objects in Moscow and Tambov regions located over 500 km and about 700 km from the front line used for sanctioned drone and navigation equipment components (Source: @UkraineNow/82742).

Commander of Unmanned Systems Forces Brovdi reported strikes on Mykhailivska oil depot in Stavropol Krai third time and eight electrical substations in occupied Crimea plus four Russian shadow fleet vessels in Black Sea (Source: @UkraineNow/82762).

GenStab reported Ukrainian strike on oil depot in Moscow region, tankers and guard ship Svetlyak in Kerch second such ship in two days, and railway bridge over Bila river near Sabivka Luhansk region (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
Human rights ombudsman Lubynets reported 141 mobilization rights violations in first week of July including illegal detentions and forced coercion (Source: @UkraineNow/82741).
Police opened criminal case after TCC servicemen in Lviv beat a 34-year-old man and forcibly dragged him into a minibus causing light injuries (Source: @UkraineNow/82746).
Zelensky stated he spoke with Fedorov and Syrsky and said army decisions will be worked out amid protests over defense minister dismissal (Source: @UkraineNow/82751).
Ukrainian forces struck Mykhailivska oil depot in Stavropol Krai for third time in two weeks, a critical fuel hub distributing to Lukoil gas stations per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101653).
Zelensky confirmed strikes on two logistics objects in Moscow and Tambov regions over 500 and 700 km from front used for sanctioned drone components (Source: @UkraineNow/82742).
Russian MoD stated 140 Ukrainian drones were intercepted overnight over RF regions and Azov and Black Sea waters (Source: @tass_agency/385928).

Chair of Federation Council intl affairs committee Karasin said response to Ukrainian strikes on Wildberries logistics centers will be harsh and called strikes a disgrace (Source: @tass_agency/385896).
Russian MoD reported RF forces struck VPK enterprises and logistics centers in Kyiv and Kyiv region and port Yuzhny infrastructure (Source: @tass_agency/385922).
Deputy FM Rudenko said Japanese deployment of US Typhon systems threatens Russian Far East and Beijing positive impact on Brussels benefits Europeans (Source: @tass_agency/385919).
DeepState map update shows enemy advanced near Pazeno and Rodinskoye on the eastern front (Source: @DeepStateUA/23664).
Russian forces dropped three guided aerial bombs on Kramatorsk killing 2 people and wounding 1 per Donetsk OVA head Filashkin who urged evacuation (Source: @UkraineNow/82749).
Russian guided aerial bombs hit private sector in Zaporizhzhia destroying and damaging homes and outbuildings wounding five including 14-year-old boy and 17-year-old girl (Source: @UkraineNow/82748).
Ukrainian forces struck railway bridge over Bila river near Sabivka in Luhansk region used by enemy for military logistics per GenStab (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
Kpszsu reported drone heading toward Kryvyi Rih from southeast and another toward Komyshuvakha Zaporizhzhia region from southeast (Source: @kpszsu/69121).
Kpszsu noted enemy tactical aviation activity on southern and southeastern directions threatening frontline oblasts with air munitions (Source: @kpszsu/69127).
Kpszsu tracked reactive drones toward Sumy from northwest and toward Slavutych Chernihiv from north (Source: @kpszsu/69137).
Reactive controlled drone reported near Losynivka in Chernihiv region per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101659).
Multiple reactive drones tracked in Chernihiv region toward Nizhyn, Ponornytsia, Olyshivka from east/northeast/southwest per kpszsu and eRadarrua (Source: @kpszsu/69153).
Mon1tor reported ballistic missile past Chernihiv toward Kyiv and three ballistic missiles on Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69225).
Kpszsu reported reactive drone toward Kozyatyn Vinnytsia from northeast and drone over Chernihiv city (Source: @kpszsu/69061).
Eradarrua reported reconnaissance drone near Novhorod-Siverskyi and two drones near Hadiach Poltava (Source: @eRadarrua/101664).
Kpszsu reported new groups of reactive drones toward Odesa/Chornomorsk from Black Sea and rocket on Zatoka and Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi (Source: @kpszsu/69059).
Mon1tor reported 4 rockets on Pivdenne/Chornomorske and rocket on Zatoka (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69234).
Russian MoD reported strikes on port Yuzhny infrastructure per tass_agency (Source: @tass_agency/385922).
Ukrainian strikes hit eight electrical substations in occupied Crimea including PS 110/10 kV Darsan near Yalta burning after attack (Source: @eRadarrua/101651).
Ukrainian middle strikes worked on targets in Azov Sea and Black Sea waters and occupied Crimea per Zelensky (Source: @UkraineNow/82742).
Kpszsu tracked reactive drone in Zaporizhzhia district northwest course and on Zaporizhzhia from northwest (Source: @kpszsu/69139).

Overnight 19 July Russia launched 166 air assets: 10 Tsircon, 25 Iskander-M/S-400, 3 Oniks, 3 Kh-59/69, 125 Shahed/Gerbera/Italmas/Parodiya/Banderol drones; 126 downed/suppressed (Source: @kpszsu/69144).
Mon1tor reported over 42 ballistic missiles launched at Kyiv and region calling it a record (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69204).
Kpszsu warned of ballistic weapon threat from north/east/southeast and from Bryansk/Kursk regions (Source: @kpszsu/69095).
Combat operations ongoing over Black Sea against guided reactive drone per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101656).
Mon1tor reported reactive Shahed from Chernihiv to Kyiv Boryspil district and ballistic missile falling on right bank of capital (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69235).
Russian MoD said 140 Ukrainian drones intercepted over RF regions and Azov/Black Seas overnight (Source: @tass_agency/385928).

key_developments: Russian forces launched massive combined strike on Ukraine night of 19 July with 166 assets including 41 missiles and 125 drones, main direction Kyiv, 126 suppressed (Source: @kpszsu/69144).
Ukrainian forces struck Mykhailivska oil depot Stavropol Krai third time and eight Crimea substations plus four Black Sea shadow fleet vessels per Brovdi (Source: @UkraineNow/82762).
Zelensky confirmed strikes on logistics objects in Moscow and Tambov regions 500 and 700 km from front used for sanctioned drone parts (Source: @UkraineNow/82742).
Enemy advanced near Pazeno and Rodinskoye per DeepState map update on eastern front (Source: @DeepStateUA/23664).
Russian guided bombs on Kramatorsk killed 2 wounded 1; Zaporizhzhia bombs wounded five including two children (Source: @UkraineNow/82749).
GenStab reported strike on Moscow oil depot, Kerch Svetlyak guard ship, and Luhansk railway bridge at Sabivka (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
Karasin promised harsh response to Ukrainian strikes on Wildberries logistics centers calling them disgrace (Source: @tass_agency/385896).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces demonstrated capacity for record-scale combined missile and drone strikes with over 42 ballistic missiles on Kyiv alone and 166 assets overall on 19 July, indicating sustained strategic bombardment capability (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69204). Ukrainian deep strikes on Moscow and Tambov logistics over 500-700 km and Stavropol oil hub show extended reach against RF energy and drone supply chains (Source: @UkraineNow/82742). Karasin's threat of harsh response to Wildberries strikes signals potential escalation of Russian retaliatory strikes on Ukrainian cities (Source: @tass_agency/385896). Continued eastern advances near Pazeno and Rodinskoye and aerial bomb strikes on Kramatorsk pose acute threat to frontline civilians (Source: @DeepStateUA/23664).
sections.regional_response: Botswana ministry warned citizens are deceived into fighting for Russia against Ukraine in growing fraud cases showing foreign recruitment exploitation (Source: @UkraineNow/82753). EU expressed concern over Ukrainian military procurement programs signed by dismissed minister Fedorov per EUobserver (Source: @tass_agency/385895). NATO's promised 140 billion euro two-year aid to Ukraine may be unfulfillable per Swiss paper due to uneven burden sharing (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31736). Russian deputy FM Rudenko cited Beijing positive influence on Brussels as beneficial for Ukraine settlement (Source: @tass_agency/385915).
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil infrastructure including Stavropol and Moscow depots correlate with reported US diesel price surge past 5 dollars per gallon after RF export ban (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31723). Chief of staff 11th Army Corps Sobko warned army needs urgent changes or defeat possible after Fedorov dismissal (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31726). Zelensky advisor Leshchenko said protester message heard but time needed on Fedorov rallies (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31740). TASS reported VSU forcing Colombians' relatives to travel at own cost for payments per father of surrendered Colombian (Source: @tass_agency/385917).
